evidence: Matches the 'TX fees and policy' label and modifies standardness rules in 'src/policy/policy.cpp' and 'src/policy/policy.h'.
rationale: Standardizing unstructured Taproot annexes introduces meaningful relay capability for wallets and protocols relying on annex data. The PR addresses the limitation where 'BIP 341 Taproot annexes are currently treated as non-standard by mempool policy, preventing nodes from relaying or accepting standard transactions that utilize annexes', expanding standardness with an opt-in rule to mitigate third-party inflation risks.
